sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Audit and Accountability Policy establishes standards for logging system events and ensuring traceability within {system_name} operated by {org_name}. It applies to {boundary} handling {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Audit Log Creation and Retention

questions.prompt: What event types are specified for audit logging?
What content is defined for audit records?
How are audit records created by system components?
How is audit record content enforced?
What retention requirements are defined for audit records?
How are audit records retained in accordance with requirements?

sections.body: Audit event types to log are specified by {event_types_logged}. Required audit record content is defined by {audit_record_content_def}. System components create audit logs via {audit_record_generation}. Generated audit logs contain the required content per {audit_record_content_enf}. Audit record retention rules are specified in {retention_requirements_def}. Retention of records is executed through {retention_enforcement}.

sections.heading: 3. User Action Traceability

questions.prompt: What audit record content is defined to uniquely trace user actions?
How do created audit records support user action traceability?

sections.body: To uniquely trace actions of individual users audit content requirements are defined by {traceability_content_def}. Audit records contain the necessary unique user identification content as enforced by {traceability_content_enf}.
